definition: Frame 28, final physical substep of both 520 N/m Harbor garments. Use saved native predictor, velocities, actual targets, physical energies, contact friction, timestep and solver output. Freeze all outside nodes at their actual returned positions and solve the mobile nodal momentum equations, local sewing constitutive equations, and moving capsule friction/complementarity as one root. Compare two shoulder endpoints only, the six vertices of the front/back warp faces, and the one-ring neighboring those faces. This is conditional on the measured boundary displacement and preceding state.
outcome: A converged conditional solve crossing 15% is a model/trajectory limitation for this loading and boundary. A force discrepancy alone does not predict a garment pass. A failed conditional root is inconclusive.
